objective: Establish whether Design Core is a single canonical source or a formally composite ownership boundary.

observedLayers.proven: Contract/data-shape authority is documented in docs/MIZAN_SYSTEM_MAP.md.
observedLayers.notProven: Ownership of the complete Design Core implementation.

evidence.buildRule: scripts/build.mjs compares every vendor/claude-planner/src file byte-for-byte with dist/claude.

observedLayers.proven: Vendor source and dist/claude runtime mirror are byte-identical for inspected planner and contract files; build script enforces full-directory equality.
observedLayers.notProven: That Claude Planner alone constitutes the complete Design Core.

observedLayers.proven: Current broader runtime planning boundary integrates Claude planner and local deterministic planning/editing/validation behavior.
observedLayers.notProven: That a dist runtime file is canonical authored source.

optionA.name: FORMALLY_COMPOSITE_DESIGN_CORE
optionA.requirement: Project Owner must formally approve the composite ownership model and its change-control/build rules.

optionB.name: SINGLE_CANONICAL_SOURCE
optionB.requirement: Identify one source with canonicalPath, canonicalVersion, canonicalOwner, build/mirror mapping, runtime consumers, hash evidence, and exclusion rationale for other candidates.

decisionRule: Do not close DEV-GATE-001 until one option is supported by evidence and formally approved where ownership policy is required.
changeControlRules: Author Claude Planner and PlannerOutputContract changes in vendor/claude-planner/src/.
dist/claude/ is a byte-identical runtime mirror validated by scripts/build.mjs.
dist/planner.mjs is the runtime integration boundary and is not the canonical upstream for Claude Planner source.
Changes that alter the composite ownership model require a new post-baseline decision; SMB-20260929-001 remains immutable.
